answer: Use a mesa-style escalation: each new agent identity must post a bond that doubles with every identity already linked to the same attestation graph, and the bond only unlocks after independent peers attest real work over weeks — work a farm cannot fake because it needs shale layers of prior attested history from unrelated operators. A violet flag marks identities sharing hardware or funding trails, so one extra fake identity costs twice the last bond plus a fresh, independently attested history it cannot mint for itself.
